meta.name: ai-podcast-creation
meta.description: Create AI-powered podcasts with text-to-speech, music, and audio editing. Tools: Kokoro TTS, DIA TTS, Chatterbox, AI music generation, media merger. Capabilities: multi-voice conversations, background music, intro/outro, full episodes. Use for: podcast production, audiobooks, voice content, audio newsletters. Triggers: podcast, ai podcast, text to speech podcast, audio content, voice over, ai audiobook, multi voice, conversation ai, notebooklm alternative, audio generation, podcast automation, ai narrator, voice content, audio newsletter, podcast maker

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI合成语音，制作带配乐和音效的播客节目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把文字内容转成专业感的音频节目，而不需要自己录音
copy.tagline_en: Turn text into podcasts with AI voices, music, and sound effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn written content into professional audio shows without recording yourself

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过命令行工具把文字变成带语音、音乐和音效的音频，能生成单人口播、多人对话、有声书等播客内容。
howto.when: 当你提出制作播客、有声书、语音内容等音频时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个关于人工智能的5分钟播客。
say.note: 会生成旁白并合并成音频。

say.text: 把这份文档变成两位主播的对话节目。
say.note: 会调用多语音和音频合并。

say.text: 给这段语音加上轻柔的背景音乐。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses a command-line tool to turn text into audio with speech, music, and effects—producing solo, multi-voice, or audiobook podcasts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a podcast, audiobook, or voice content, or request audio generation.

say_en.text: Create a 5-minute podcast about artificial intelligence.
say_en.note: Will generate narration and merge into audio.

say_en.text: Turn this document into a two-host dialogue show.
say_en.note: Will use multiple voices and audio merging.

say_en.text: Add soft background music to this voice clip.
say_en.note: Will generate music and mix it.
